exposure: Prenatal ethanol exposure (2.5 to 5.0% w/v liquid diet)
outcome: Reduction of serotonergic (5-HTergic) neurons in midbrain raphe nuclei
cohort: Pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats were used, and their fetuses were examined.
finding: Prenatal ethanol exposure significantly reduced the number of 5-HTergic neurons in the midbrain raphe nuclei of fetuses, but this reduction was alleviated by the enhancement of signaling via 5-HT2A/2C receptors during the fetal period.
gest_age: Exposure: Gestational days (GDs) 10 to 20 for ethanol, GDs 13 to 19 for DOI; Observation: GD 19 or 20
